summary: We developed Planet Quest, an interactive web-based educational platform designed to make learning about our solar system engaging, accessible, and intuitive. Traditional astronomy education often relies on static textbooks and dense data tables, making it difficult for students and general learners to grasp planetary scale, orbital mechanics, and unique celestial features. Planet Quest addresses this challenge by transforming space exploration into a hands-on digital experience. Users can explore planets interactively, visualize spatial relationships, and test their knowledge through gamified challenges. This project is important because fostering early curiosity and visual literacy in space science lowers the barrier to STEM education, turning passive readers into active explorers.
details:
lanet Quest allows users to navigate through a virtual representation of the solar system. Users can select individual celestial bodies to inspect key data points (such as mass, orbital period, surface temperature, and atmospheric composition), compare planetary scales, and complete interactive quests or quizzes to reinforce learning.

  • Benefits: Simplifies complex astronomical data into digestible, interactive visual modules; accessible directly in a web browser without specialized hardware.
  • Intended Impact: To inspire students, educators, and space enthusiasts to explore planetary science interactively, improving retention and sparking long-term interest in STEM fields.
